newsitem.title: FRANCE: French govt to sell 7.5 pct stake in CLF.
newsitem.headline: French govt to sell 7.5 pct stake in CLF.

text.p: French finance minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday that the government planned to sell it 7.5 percent stake in bank Credit Local de France.
The disposal involves the sale of 2.8 million shares, Arthuis said in a statement.
Arthuis said the sale was taking place ahead of the planned alliance of the French public sector lender with Belgian bank Credit Communal de Belgique (CCB).
The alliance in which the two banks will take cross-holdings in each other's share capital comes into effect at the end of the year.
The state conducted a tender among several banks and ABN Amro Rothschild was chosen to handle the placement into the market, the statement said.

Arthuis decided after a wide tender process, to choose Credit Lyonnais, as adviser to the government on the sale of certain minority stakes in private companies. Credit Lyonnais advised the state on the sale of the Credit Local stake.
